g.text: Comparison of existing inventories with refinery throughput as at July 2026.
Decline since peak on 3 April 2026 is at 6.4 million barrels per week; 26 weeks from stress threshold at this (hypothetical and linear) rate.

Source: Energy Information Administration (EIA). Latest data 23 October 2026.
